title: Worker pool exhaustion under sustained load
body:
When running >200 concurrent actions, the worker pool runs out of slots and new actions queue indefinitely.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Configure pool_size=50
2. Submit 200 concurrent actions
3. Observe queue depth grows unbounded

comments.body: I can reproduce this. Setting pool_size=100 delays the issue but doesn't fix it.
Root cause: the semaphore release is missing in the error path. Fix coming in #43.
